label: French verb group derivation policy
purpose: A reproducible classifier for learner-facing French verb groups. It derives a group from canonical lemma spelling and imported morphology; it is not a replacement for a lexical source assertion.

rules.first_group: An infinitive ending in -er, unless it appears in third_group_exceptions.
rules.second_group: An infinitive ending in -ir whose imported present participle ends in -issant.
rules.third_group: Any remaining verb for which the available lemma or morphology evidence rules out the first and second groups.
